data.one_liner: Provides a custom ShapeBorder allowing different widths for each side with a single color.
data.what_it_does: It introduces a NonUniformBorder class for Flutter that enables different border widths on each side of a widget. It supports features like border radius, symmetrical configurations, and uniform borders.
use_when: You need custom borders with different widths on individual sides.
You are building custom UI elements requiring non-uniform border styling.
avoid_when: You only need standard uniform borders provided out-of-the-box by Flutter.
strengths: Allows different widths for each side of a border
Supports border radius and custom alignments
Provides convenient constructors like symmetrical and all
weaknesses: Limited to a single color for the entire border
Not documented for gradient or multi-color border support
